Education and research
Our graduate programs give you the broad skills you need for your future as a researcher, entrepreneur, and leader in engineering, academia, and industry.
Graduate students work alongside respected faculty to meet societal challenges and make a global impact through innovative and collaborative research.

Engineering education
Master of Engineering
Our Master's degrees are coursework-only programs, offering an array of courses designed to provide students with flexibility and opportunities in different career fields. This degree is offered both on campus and through CSU Online.
Explore the Master of Engineering program
Master of Science
Earn a Master of Science with interdisciplinary curriculum and research. The curriculum is designed to provide flexibility and support your research specialty. As an M.S. student, you may be involved in the design and regulatory approval of advanced medical technologies, as well as the manufacturing of health care products.
Explore the Master of Science program
Professional Science Master of Biomanufacturing and Biotechnology
There is a high demand for skilled professionals in the bioscience field, and the Professional Science Master’s program offers an excellent opportunity to enhance your skills and prepare for new roles in this ever-evolving industry.
Explore the PSM program
Doctorate of Philosophy
Our Ph.D. program will prepare you to succeed in interdisciplinary research in an academic or industry environment. As a Ph.D. student, your original research will be guided by your advisor and contribute to the knowledge base in the scientific community.
Explore the Doctorate of Philosophy program
Get an online Graduate Certificate in Biomaterials and Tissue Engineering
Gain an in-depth understanding of biomaterials by studying the properties, processing, and economics of biomedical and biotechnology applications:
Explore how engineered materials are used in medical devices and identify design materials for biological engineering purposes.
Analyze functionalities of various biological species in tissue engineering.
Think more critically about bioengineering concepts as they relate to emerging areas of tissue engineering and biomaterials.
Effectively communicate and discuss advanced biomaterials concepts with technical experts and professionals.
Apply now through CSU Online
